exposure: COVID-19 pandemic (before vs. during first wave)
cohort: A sample of 122 pregnant women selected prior to the COVID-19 pandemic and a sample of 181 pregnant women studied during the first wave of the pandemic.
finding: The prevalence and scores of depression and anxiety symptoms were significantly higher among pregnant women and those in the postpartum period during the COVID-19 pandemic compared to those before the pandemic.
cross-section timing: Before the COVID-19 pandemic and during the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic.
